stage1.impression: A strong idea, eight jewel-coloured boxes glowing in a row against a night concrete wall with wet reflections, but it reads as a soft, smeared CG render, not a photograph. The wall's texture visibly tiles and is smeared by the denoiser. Instead of eight tall washes it carries one smooth red-to-grey gradient. The speakers are small, the Smoke unit sinks into the dark, and the puddle reflections break up into camouflage blotches.

blocking_9: Eight distinct, saturated washes rising from each speaker up the wall, brighter above each unit than between them (on-axis vs gap luminance ratio at least 1.6 at mid-wall height), each in its speaker's own hue.
Concrete that reads as real board-formed concrete at real scale, with no visible repeating blemish and with crisp board-grain micro-detail (no denoiser smear).
Clean, continuous reflections of the speakers and washes on the wet quay and the river, without blotchy puddle camouflage.
Smoke black reading as a silhouette against a lit wall, and all eight units crisp at full resolution.
No dead black band at the quay edge or at the bottom of the frame; the river carries the washes.

defects.what: Wall texture tiles: the same blemish mark repeats about every 125 px horizontally and vertically (tex_scale 1.0 on concrete_layers_02)
Denoiser smear: blotchy, painterly patches on the wall instead of board grain and tie holes; wall top-band lum_range only 27

No per-speaker washes, only a smooth left-to-right gradient (red to grey). Above the green unit the wall is r99 g81 b75 (not green), above the violet unit r97 g108 b117 (not violet), and the wall above each unit is within about ±10 lum of the gaps
Wet paving reflections break into small, camouflage-like puddle blotches (puddle_m 0.4), so they read as noise rather than water
Quay edge is a dead black band, lum median 10
The river is murky and underlit (lum median 20); the colour streaks are faint and smeared
Smoke black speaker lost against a dark wall; the wall right of it has lum median 22 and a range of 9
The horns read as flat dark slabs with little transmitted colour, because the frame is underexposed at the top of the units
The delivered image is 1440x600 against a 2880x1200 frame setting, so the speakers are only about 100 px wide each and lose crispness

changes.problem: The wall stands too far behind the speakers (main face at y 1.35, pilasters at 1.20, about 1 m behind the cabinets' backs), so the light leaking from each cabinet spreads into one even gradient instead of eight tall washes.

evidence.measured: Wall luminance above each unit vs the adjacent gap differs by only about ±10 (e.g. 84.8 above green, 71.6 at the gap, 81.7 above blue). The hues are not the speakers': r99 g81 b75 above green.

change.setting: set.props.0, set.props.1, set.props.2 and set.props.8..24 position y (the wall assembly)
change.from: props.0 y 1.95, props.1 y 1.08, props.2 y 0.85, pilasters y 1.35
change.to: move all wall pieces forward 0.6 m: props.0 y 1.35, props.1 y 0.48, props.2 y 0.25, pilasters y 0.75 (curb front face at 0.36, which still clears the plinths' back edge at 0.265)

changes.expected: Each cabinet throws a narrow, tall, saturated column of its own colour onto the wall that is visibly brighter than the gaps between units, and overlapping hues blend at the seams.

changes.problem: The uplights are too weak against the moon, so the wall is lit mostly by cool fill and the washes do not dominate.

evidence.measured: Above Ice blue: r74 g83 b90, lum 81.7, barely blue. Above Haze violet: r97 g108 b117.

changes.expected: The washes carry the wall: the blue column measures b at least 1.35x r, and the gaps between washes fall to about lum 45 so the columns separate.

changes.problem: The concrete texture visibly repeats about every metre, which immediately reads as CG.

evidence.measured: In a 2x crop, an identical blemish mark recurs about every 125 px on both axes.

change.setting: set.props.0/1/2/8..24 tex_scale (and per-pilaster tex_offset already varies)
change.to: tex_scale 2.6, with vary_m 3.5 raised to 6.0 so the tone variation breaks up any residual repeat; keep bump 2.4

changes.expected: No recognisable repeating mark across the wall. Boards run full-width at believable 150-200 mm heights, with random tie holes.

changes.problem: The denoiser has smeared the micro-detail, so the concrete and the reflections look painted.

evidence.measured: Upper wall lum_range 27.7 (p5 49, p95 77). The crops show soft blotches instead of board grain.

change.from: current samples, denoiser on beauty only, delivered at 1440x600
change.to: deliver at the full 2880x1200 frame, 1024+ samples with adaptive threshold 0.005, OpenImageDenoise with albedo+normal passes in high-quality prefilter mode

changes.expected: Crisp board grain, tie holes and speaker edges at 100% view, with no blotching.

changes.problem: The wet quay breaks the reflections into small camouflage blotches rather than reading as a sheet of water.

evidence.measured: The reflection under the green unit is lum_range 205, p5 31 to p95 235, broken into patches about 10-20 px across.

changes.expected: Each speaker casts a continuous vertical colour reflection on the quay, with only occasional dry patches.

changes.problem: The lower 95 px (the quay edge and the river) is dead and murky, and wastes a fifth of the frame.

evidence.measured: Quay edge band lum median 10.2. River band lum median 20.3, p95 57.

change.from: ripple 0.35, ripple_m 0.35; edge box granite 0.12 high
change.to: ripple 0.12, ripple_m 1.2 (long, calm streaks of the washes); lower props.4 to z -0.2 and make it wet granite so it catches a highlight line

changes.expected: The river carries long, soft coloured streaks under each unit, and the quay edge reads as a thin lit lip rather than a black bar.

changes.problem: Smoke black merges with the darkest part of the wall, and its silhouette is lost.

evidence.measured: Wall to the right of Smoke: lum median 22, range 9. The unit's body median is about 20.

change.to: 750 (Smoke transmits least, so give its lamp more power to equalise its wash)

changes.expected: A neutral grey wash behind Smoke at about lum 70, so the dark box reads as a silhouette with its acrylic edges catching light.

changes.problem: There is little sense of night air: the light does not visibly rise from the uplights.

evidence.measured: Top band lum median 59, range 27, flat and uniform. There is no visible glow volume above the units.

change.to: density 0.03, box y max 1.3 (so the haze fills the space between the speakers and the moved wall)

changes.expected: Faint coloured glow columns in the air above each unit, fading with height, which give depth without fogging the wall texture.

out_of_scope.request: Make the horns transmit more coloured light, so they do not read as dark slabs
out_of_scope.why: The horn's resin, tint and shape are product properties (acoustically set). The speaker cannot change.

out_of_scope.request: Let more of the lamp's light pass through the cabinet's lower body
out_of_scope.why: The batts stop light as real batts do, and the card fixes this.
